title: The Distant Signal Anew
author: B. M. Joubert
blurb: Zephyrine Almeida, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
